entities.name: property use and parking
entities.description: This topic covers regulations and issues related to property usage, including parking rights, public right-of-way usage, and restrictions on property development and use, especially concerning church properties and residential areas.

entities.name: school site plan
entities.description: This topic involves the planning, approval, and regulation of school site developments, including master site plans, building replacements, and compliance with city ordinances and public hearings.

entities.name: church property and restrictions
entities.description: This topic pertains to properties owned by churches, including restrictions outlined in restrictive covenants, property ownership details, and conditions for demolition and development, as well as usage restrictions related to church and clergy residences.

entities.name: swales
entities.description: This topic addresses the use and regulation of swales as part of stormwater management systems, including their use as public right-of-way for parking and related concerns about property and street usage.

entities.name: residence use of property
entities.description: This topic covers regulations and issues related to the use of properties for residential purposes, including restrictions on property modifications, usage rights, and related community concerns.
